nuggets.text: The Cowboys' War Memorial Stadium sits at 7,222 feet, the highest stadium in FBS.
The Cowboys play on Jonah Field, named for a natural gas field in Sublette County, Wyoming.
The Cowboys' field is skewed about 10 degrees off the usual north-south alignment.
Saturday is a Stripe Out, with Cowboys fans wearing brown or gold depending on where they sit.
The Cowboys are 53-12-1 all-time in non-conference home openers.
The Cowboys opened a season against Colorado State this year for the first time since 1964.
The Cowboys have won nine straight over Northern Colorado, a run that stretches from 1937 to 2022.
Cowboys coach Jay Sawvel played linebacker at Mount Union from 1989 to 1993.
The Cowboys retired Josh Allen's No. 17 on November 22, 2025.
The Cowboys' fight song is Ragtime Cowboy Joe.
